spec.description: Permicav XV™ is a vapour-permeable insulation designed to reduce condensation risk in walls with cavities, suitable for low-rise structures.
install: Lay outer leaf or brickwork with wall ties in place.
Clip Kingspan AIR-CELL Spacer BiscuitsTM onto every second wall tie, or as required to maintain a nominal 20 mm air space.
Roll out Kingspan AIR-CELL Permicav XV™ horizontally and fix to outside of internal wall frame, working from the bottom up.
Allow 50 mm overlap between top and bottom layers and tape with 48 mm reinforced foil tape.
Cut Kingspan AIR-CELL carefully around doors, windows and other openings.
Penetrations for wall ties or services should be neatly cut to minimise gaps.
clearances: Leave minimum 100 mm clearance around heat producing flues or light fittings.
limitations: Intense heat above 105˚ C must be avoided.
Contact with sparks and flame from blow torches, welders, cutting tools, etc. must be avoided.

Specification Guide
The wall insulation fixed to the brickwork over the wall ties 
shall be Kingspan AIR-CELL Permicav XV™ fibre-free, thermo 
reflective insulation, comprising a cross-linked, closed-cell 
foam core sandwiched with an anti-glare foil facing on one 
side and a plain foil facing on the other side manufactured 
by Kingspan Insulation Pty Ltd, and shall be installed in 
accordance with the instructions issued by them.
